items.question: What are the exact dimensions?
items.answer: Standard and square sizes are available. Standard size is 3.5" x 2.0" and square size is 2.16" x 3.3".

items.question: How thick is the paper?
items.answer: We start at premium and go all the way to extra fancy. Original thickness starts at 16pt, super starts at 18pt, luxe is 32pt, and cotton is 17pt.

items.question: Can I print on both sides?
items.answer: Yes. All of our custom business cards can be printed full-colour on both sides at no extra cost.

items.question: Will my colours print accurately?
items.answer: We print in CMYK. Designs created in RGB will be auto-converted, which can shift bright tones slightly.

items.question: What file format should I upload?
items.answer: PDF (preferred), PNG, or JPG at 300 dpi or higher. Include bleed on every edge.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Standard delivery takes 3–5 working days. Next Day Delivery is available on selected products before 12pm.
